notes.title: ⏳ Release Delay Announcement – Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44790310/73621b8dff81df63500ea399dd84c664af943e2a.png[/img]
Hi everyone,

[h1][b]We’d like to inform you that the release of Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX has been slightly delayed to April 18 at 4PM PST.[/b]
[/h1]
We're adding the final touches and a few last-minute features to ensure the best and most polished experience possible for all of you.

We truly understand your excitement, and we apologize for this short delay. But we believe this extra time will allow us to deliver a much better game for you to enjoy.

🙏 Thank you for your patience and continued support!

With love,
The Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX Team

notes.title: Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX Demo Launched!
notes.content:
[h1]The demo version of our game Academy Love Saga: Tennis Angels EX is NOW OUT! 🎮✨[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3099640/Academy_Love_Saga_Tennis_Angels_EX/

Step into the shoes of a coach at a prestigious sports academy’s tennis club, where you’ll face the ultimate challenge: winning over a group of stunning girls who all, unfortunately, dislike you! Can you handle the heat? Only the most skilled will succeed!

[h2]⚡ Get ready for:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Intense tennis matches with dynamic, fast-paced gameplay
[*] Powerful abilities to help you turn the tide in your favor
[*] And of course, winning the hearts of the girls who challenge you!
[/list]

We’d love to hear what you think about the demo, so please share your feedback with us on Steam or Discord! 🎧

And if you haven’t yet, be sure to wishlist the full game to stay updated on future releases and developments!

Thank you for your support, and good luck, coaches! 🏆🎾
